docstring: For every number field, the maximal abelian extension is generated by the periodic points of one flat separated scheme of finite type with a Λ-structure over its ring of integers. This is known for the rational numbers and for imaginary quadratic fields. It is the universal form of Question 4 of Borger and de Smit, whose answer is unknown; one number field with no such scheme would refute it. It is one published precise formulation of explicit class field theory, not the only reading of Hilbert 12.
references: [Borger and de Smit, Explicit class field theory and the algebraic geometry of Λ-rings](https://arxiv.org/abs/1809.02295)
[Gurney, Elliptic curves with complex multiplication and Λ-structures](https://arxiv.org/abs/1710.08674)
